requirements.RC-1375: Final closure is not equivalent to merely coding a subset of requirements.
requirements.RC-1376: All product and quality requirements live in one traceability matrix.
requirements.RC-1379: TR completion is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1380: EN completion is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1381: Offline behavior is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1382: Free behavior is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1383: PRO behavior is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1384: Backup round-trip evidence is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1385: PDF output evidence is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1386: Calculation reference evidence is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1387: UI real-device evidence is checked where applicable.
requirements.RC-1389: A requirement cannot close until every applicable mandatory dimension is green.
requirements.RC-1390: Traceability is fail-closed against assumed completion.
requirements.RC-1391: Final CI checks exact requirement count.
requirements.RC-1392: Deleting a binding requirement breaks CI through count/order/source binding.
requirements.RC-1394: Removing required test evidence breaks final traceability.
requirements.RC-1395: Missing TR evidence breaks applicable final traceability.
requirements.RC-1396: Missing EN evidence breaks applicable final traceability.
requirements.RC-1397: Calculation golden/reference changes cannot silently pass final release.
requirements.RC-1398: Broken backup round-trip blocks final release.
requirements.RC-1399: Broken/unreadable PDF evidence blocks final release.
requirements.RC-1400: Broken offline smoke evidence blocks final release.
requirements.RC-1401: Broken PRO entitlement evidence blocks final release.
requirements.RC-1402: Broken Free entitlement evidence blocks final release.
requirements.RC-1403: The release artifact must be produced from the exact commit that passed gates.
requirements.RC-1404: A later manual commit cannot reuse the same final identity without exact commit/artifact revalidation.

lifecycleRule: IMPLEMENTED may be recorded after the structural and fail-closed traceability gates pass. VERIFIED/DONE requires all RC-0001..RC-1442 DONE/unblocked plus an exact final release manifest whose tested commit SHA, artifact-producing commit SHA and artifact SHA-256 match.
